verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ENJALA n'ennyonta
Binnuma-:ompeereze
Amazzi g'obulamu-
N'emmere-eva gy'oli.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ggwe-eyabetentebwa,
Ku bwange,Mukama;
-Omugaati gw'obulamu
Gumpe, nneme-okufa.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ggwe,Ayi Muzabibbu
Oguleeta-obulamu
Onnywese-enviinyo yo,
Envumule-omwoyo,

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Nkooye n'okukoowa,
-Olugemdo lunnyinze;
-Ondiise ku mmere yo,
-Ombeere,Mulokozi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Eddungu weeriri,
Lye mpitamu,naye
Ka nnyanguwe gy'oli
Ennyonta yange-eggwe.
